Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces. A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.Key Features· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode· Bonus prequel content: Chapter ZeroSoftware description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 337 MBNintendo Switch 2: 337 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. Additional accessories may be required(sold separately). See support for details.No. of playersSingle system (1-2)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
